limitations.note: The rewrite made `number` a register but drove it with the new count instead of sampling the pre-edge `num` alongside `zero`, so count and load values appeared one cycle too early.
The rewrite changed `zero` during asynchronous reset from 0 to 1, although the fix should preserve the original reset value.
The test expected each loaded value on the same edge that captured it, so its PASS confirmed the rewrite's timing assumption rather than checking the required one-cycle output delay.
